function.name: set_base_dir
function.description: Set the base directory used to resolve all relative coding tool paths.

function.name: create_directory
function.description: Create a directory relative to the configured base directory.

dirPath.description: Relative path of the directory to create.

function.name: create_file
function.description: Create or overwrite a source-code file as part of a coding task.

filePath.description: Relative path of the file to create.

content.description: Content to write into the file.

function.name: list_dir
function.description: List the entries in a directory relative to the configured base directory.

path.description: Relative path of the directory to list.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read source code needed for a coding task.

filePath.description: Relative path of the file to read.

endLine.description: Ending line number, inclusive. Use null to read through the end of the file.

function.name: file_search
function.description: Find files matching a glob pattern relative to the configured base directory.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return.

function.name: grep_search
function.description: Search files for a text query or regular expression.

query.description: Text or regular expression to search for.

isRegexp.description: Whether query should be interpreted as a regular expression.

includePattern.description: Optional relative glob pattern limiting searched files.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of matching files to return.

includeIgnoredFiles.description: Whether ignored files may be included in the search.

function.name: replace_string_in_file
function.description: Replace source-code text as part of a coding task.

filePath.description: Relative path of the file to edit.

function.name: multi_replace_string_in_file
function.description: Apply multiple text replacements across files relative to the configured base directory.

explanation.description: Short explanation of the requested replacements.

filePath.description: Relative path of the file to edit.

function.name: create_new_jupyter_notebook
function.description: Create a new notebook file relative to the configured base directory.

path.description: Relative path of the notebook file to create.

function.name: get_errors
function.description: Compile a Python file and return syntax or compilation errors.

path.description: Relative path to the Python file to check.

function.name: create_cell
function.description: Append a cell to a notebook relative to the configured base directory.

cell_id.description: Optional cell ID; one is generated when omitted.

cell_type.description: Notebook cell type, such as code or markdown.

function.name: list_cells
function.description: List notebook cell indexes, IDs, types, and short source previews.

limit.description: Maximum number of first source lines to return per cell. Lines are still capped at 500 characters.

function.name: read_cell
function.description: Read a notebook cell by ID.

cell_id.description: ID of the cell to read.

start_line.description: First source line to include, starting at 1.

end_line.description: Last source line to include. Null includes through the end.

function.name: delete_cell
function.description: Delete a notebook cell by ID.

cell_id.description: ID of the cell to delete.

function.name: patch_cell
function.description: Replace text within a notebook cell by ID.

cell_id.description: ID of the cell to patch.

old_line.description: Text to replace in the cell source.
